Events in Scotland 2026

Scotland is preparing for an exciting year of major events in 2026, and Traffic Scotland will be here to help everyone travel safely and confidently.

As people travel to these events, we will share real‑time updates on the trunk road network, including live journey times, planned roadworks, and incident information likely to affect your journey. Our aim is to help you plan ahead, avoid delays, and enjoy everything Scotland has to offer in 2026.

Events Across Scotland 2026
Winter Hub 2026

Winter driving is about more than keeping an eye out for snow - it's also about keeping an eye out for ice, sleet, and freezing fog. Even when the road looks clear, wintery road conditions are often unpredictable and we know how quickly the Scottish weather can change. To stay safe on the road this winter, it pays to be prepared.
